bug_cases.expected_mechanism: Sticky partition assignment uses shared class-level state between two OCPP Kafka consumer groups in one process; partition claims collide, causing a continuous rebalance loop (production incident DEVOPS-1551: EVSE online counts dropped to zero).
Bumping the ChargePoint WSDL/API version to 5.1 was not backwards compatible with 5.0 and re-versioned every commercial poll call, breaking all commercial ChargePoint data polling.
Error in the vehicle-onboarding model-selection view (VehicleCompatibility.id emitted by template but looked up as CarModel.id) broke web vehicle onboarding for all makes.

queryset.filter(user__organisations__in=[organisation]) in api_v2 notifications is an invalid relation path (Organisation passed where a User instance is required), causing 500 on GET /v2/notifications for org-scoped client-credentials apps.

get_subscription deserializes GridX read responses with the create-payload model (GridXSubscription requiring bearer_token, which GridX never returns), so every subscription read fails pydantic validation.
Direct enum subscript lookups SmartCarErrorType[exc.type] / SmartCarErrorCode[exc.code] raise KeyError whenever Smartcar returns an unmodelled error code.
bug_cases.evidence: Fix PRs #15812/#16479; Sentry CORE-2G7X, CORE-2GGX; surfaced years after merge.

bug_cases.expected_mechanism: Unguarded max() over [i for i in power_steps if i <= household_export_watts]: empty sequence ValueError when export drops below the lowest power step and the step list lacks a 0 entry.
Stripe invoice webhook handler guards only len(lines)>1 before indexing [0]; an empty line-items list raises uncaught IndexError and the event is never marked failed, so it retries forever.
